text:
sam: heads-up — support escalation from ACME: p99 latency spiked after last-night rollout in us-west. customer seeing 502/timeouts. p95 went 120ms -> ~850ms :rotating_light:
support-bot: ticket #7892 created, CC'd SAM and SRE team. customer provided example request ids: r_7a3, r_7b1.
sre-oncall: thx. can someone paste a quick repro curl and the model variant rolled? we need scope.
sam: repro attached in ticket — simple /v1/generate call, model=redwood-rlhf-xl-quant, seq_len ~1024, bursts of concurrent requests from single key.
mike: immediate mitigations I'd push now: 1) divert traffic for that key to fallback model (redwood-rlhf-large-quant) 2) lower per-key concurrency to 4 3) enable CB to trip earlier. I can run commands. :thumbsup:
lina: agree. also throttle incoming client with 429s instead of letting infra queue up. short-term cache identical prompts for 30s.
jamie: add: if fallback model still slow, route to other region (us-east) — lower latency for that customer often there.
sre-oncall: mike, can you run route change? sample admin call:```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood/api/route/traffic \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"customer_id":"acme", "target":"fallback-model", "model":"redwood-rlhf-large-quant", "weight":100}'
```
mike: running now. also lowering per-key concurrency:```json
{"customer_id":"acme","max_concurrency":4}
```
infra-bot: detected config change request from mike — applying to us-west pool. rolling update in progress.
sre-oncall: enabling circuit-breaker guardrail for that route: trip at p99 >= 1.2s for 10s window -> fallback to fallback-model/region. updating SLO guardrail: p99 action -> fallback.
lina: pushing quick rate-limit override on customer key: set burst=50/s, sustained=10/s. that should protect queues.
support-bot: emailed customer with update: "We routed your traffic to a lower-latency model and applied temporary rate limits while we investigate. Please let us know if you still see 502s."
deploy-bot: canary rollback started for redwood-rlhf-xl-quant in us-west (canary id: c-2026-11). :shipit:
sre-oncall: monitoring — p95 now ~140ms, p99 ~420ms and trending down. still watching error rate.
mike: if rollback doesn't stabilize within 15m we should spin up extra dedicated capacity in us-west (add 2 x gpus) and keep fallback routing.
jamie: note for postmortem — add a guardrail: automated canary rollback when p99 > 3x baseline for >2min. also add model fallbacks to regional priority list.
sam: agreed. I'll coord with support to close ticket after stable. great work team. :clap:
sre-oncall: summary of mitigations applied: divert traffic -> smaller model, lowered concurrency, applied rate limits, circuit-breaker guardrail enabled, canary rollback started. followups: postmortem + tighten automated rollback thresholds.
support-bot: ticket #7892 updated -> awaiting customer confirmation.
sre-oncall: marking this thread resolved-to-monitor. if p99 creeps back, escalate to infra on-call.
sam: thanks everyone — keeping this thread open til end of day but looks good so far.
